column1: # Trust and merge invariant rows. Tab-separated, one line per row (or row arm, as ROW:arm).
# Read by tests/common/rows.rs (row state), tests/invariants.rs (table checks) and tests/mutants/run.sh (mutants).
# state: enforced (holds; mutant is a patch that must make the test fail) | control (holds; its guard has not landed, so nothing to mutate yet)
#        known-violation (murk breaks it today; the test fails once the target holds) | pending (needs behaviour that does not exist yet; runs only with MURK_ROWS=pending, never fails)
# fix: the change that flips the row, or - for an enforced row. binary: integration test file stem, or lib for a unit test.
# mutant: for an enforced row, the patch under tests/mutants/; otherwise the guard to disable once the fix lands.
# review: ids of the test-quality review findings the row also answers (comma-separated), or -.
